What Sharpwise covers

Sharpwise has 343 maths and English topics, from Reception to Year 6: 228 in maths and 115 in English.

Reception follows the EYFS Early Learning Goals, and Years 1 to 6 are aligned to the National Curriculum for England. This page is made from the game's own list of topics, so it changes when the game does.

Play Sharpwise

Pick a school year

Each year has its own page: every topic in plain words, ideas to try at home, and for teachers the curriculum objective each topic practises.

  • Reception

    17 topics in maths and 13 topics in English.

    For example: Count objects to 10; Compare quantities; Understanding what has been read to them.

  • Year 1

    30 topics in maths and 20 topics in English.

    For example: Count in multiples; Bonds within 20; Contractions (I'm, I'll, we'll).

  • Year 2

    43 topics in maths and 21 topics in English.

    For example: Place value; 2-digit addition; Listening.

  • Year 3

    30 topics in maths and 13 topics in English.

    For example: Count in 4s, 8s, 50s, 100s; 3-digit number and 1s, 10s, 100s mentally; Words often misspelt, words 1–50.

  • Year 4

    35 topics in maths and 17 topics in English.

    For example: Count in 6s, 7s, 9s, 25s, 1,000s; Column addition and subtraction to 4 digits; Retrieve and record information from non-fiction.

  • Year 5

    38 topics in maths and 15 topics in English.

    For example: Read, write, order, compare to 1,000,000; More than 4 digits, columnar; Distinguish between statements of fact and opinion.

  • Year 6

    35 topics in maths and 16 topics in English.

    For example: Numbers to 10,000,000; Long multiplication, up to 4 digits × 2 digits; Inferring feelings, thoughts and motives, justified with evidence.
